title: Site Kit by Google Review
description: A hands-on look at Site Kit’s setup boundary. Connected Google reporting has not been tested.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Site Kit by Google WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: Site Kit is Google’s official WordPress plugin
It connects Search Console, Analytics, and PageSpeed Insights in the WordPress dashboard
The documented setup does not require manual code editing
bestFor: Site owners who need a straightforward view of Google search and analytics signals in WordPress.
researchScope: Activated the free plugin and inspected its local/staging warning and authorization step. No Google authorization or service connection was attempted; documentation describes connected capabilities.
caveats: Analytics implementation has privacy and consent implications. Configure data collection and cookie consent for the site’s audience and legal context.
thumbnailAlt: Site Kit screenshot from its WordPress.org listing

handsOnTest.environment: Isolated local macOS PHP server; SQLite Database Integration; Chromium; free editions. Email sending disabled by a lab-only filter. No production accounts or site data.

checks.title: Activation and setup boundary
checks.detail: Activated the free plugin and opened its setup UI. It displayed the local/staging readiness warning and a Google sign-in step.

checks.title: No account changes
checks.detail: No Google authorization, service connection, Analytics configuration, or production-site change was attempted. Anonymous usage-data sharing was left off.

limitations: Connected Search Console/Analytics reports and verified public-site setup were not tested.
A public site and explicitly authorized Google account are required for a complete integration test; local activation is not proof of connected reporting.
